_comment: Dynamic/transient regions excluded from the palette regression diff. Each was verified against real pixels before being masked: (1) the project-details 'اكتُشف' line renders the wall-clock time; (2) the desktop shows through the DWM rounded top-right corner; (3) the first focusable control (the active source tile in the rail) carries the system focus visual, whose presence depends on window-activation timing; (4) the ChromeValueLabel today-count sheen is a continuously animated band, so its captured phase is arbitrary. Nothing here is painted by a token.
